info.title: OpenAPI For Motor Insurance
info.description: API's that you need to use to issue insurance policies to your clients

get.description: Returns vehicle makers that have at least one model. Use the returned code when requesting a quote with a customs number.

200.description: Vehicle makers matching the optional search term

get.description: Returns models belonging to the selected maker. The model code submitted in a customs-number quote must belong to its maker code.

200.description: Vehicle models for the selected maker

get.description: Returns body types accepted when requesting a quote with a customs number.

200.description: Vehicle body types matching the optional search term

post.description:
For getting prices with benefits. 
The Quote IDs can be used later to issue a policy

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: Set to ar to receive Arabic-localized quote content.

otp.description: The OTP received by the customer from the Request OTP API

owner_id.description: The owner's national ID (starts with 1 for Saudi nationals) or Iqama ID (starts with 2 for residents). Must be exactly 10 digits.

email.description: Email address must be valid and belongs to the customer

phone.description: Phone number must start with 05 and be 10 digits

car_sequence_number.description: Car sequence number must be 8 or 9 digits

custom_number.description: Customs card number between 100000 and 9999999999 for an imported vehicle. When provided, maker_code, model_code, and body_type_code are required, and car_sequence_number must be omitted.

maker_code.description: Required with custom_number. Use a code returned by GET /vehicle-makers.

model_code.description: Required with custom_number. Use a code returned by GET /vehicle-models for the selected maker_code.

body_type_code.description: Required with custom_number. Use a code returned by GET /vehicle-body-types.

is_ownership_transfer.description: Indicates if the ownership is being transferred

current_car_owner_id.description: Required if is_ownership_transfer is true; the current owner's national ID (starts with 1) or Iqama ID (starts with 2). Must be exactly 10 digits.

car_model_year.description: Car model year between 1950 and next year

start_date.description: Desired policy start date in YYYY-MM-DD. Must be between tomorrow and 28 days from today (inclusive). The platform validates this range server-side.

drivers.description: List of drivers for the vehicle. When provided, the sum of all driving_percentage values must equal 100, and the owner must be included among the drivers.

owner_id.description: Driver's national ID (starts with 1 for Saudi nationals) or Iqama ID (starts with 2 for residents). Must be exactly 10 digits.

driving_percentage.description: Percentage of driving for this driver. Valid values are 25, 50, 75, or 100. The sum of all drivers' percentages must equal 100.

get.description: Returns the copy you are expected to show alongside motor quotes — the provider attribution and its Insurance Authority licence, the Shahin support routes, and the buyer FAQ. English and Arabic are returned together, so a bilingual page needs a single request and does not have to hold the strings itself. Fetch it rather than hard-coding the wording: changes reach you without an integration change.

200.description: The guideline texts, keyed by locale

provider.supervision: Under supervision of the Insurance Authority, license

faq.question: What is the difference between TPL and Comprehensive insurance?
faq.answer: TPL covers damage you cause to others, while Comprehensive also covers damage to your own vehicle, subject to the policy terms.

faq.question: ما الفرق بين التأمين ضد الغير والتأمين الشامل؟
faq.answer: يغطي التأمين ضد الغير الأضرار التي تتسبب بها للآخرين، بينما يغطي التأمين الشامل كذلك الأضرار التي تلحق بمركبتك، وفقاً لشروط الوثيقة.

post.description: Uploads the five vehicle photos required for comprehensive cover and registers them with the insurance provider against the selected quote. Call it before requesting the payment OTP: the provider downloads and checks every image during this call, so a photo it cannot read is rejected while the customer can still retake it, rather than after they have paid. All five are required together — a partial set is rejected — and the photos can only be submitted once for a vehicle; a second upload returns 409. The quote_price_id must belong to a comprehensive quote. See Best practices and branding guidelines for what to show alongside the quotes.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the quote request the photos belong to

quote_price_id.description: The quote price the customer selected, from POST /quote-requests. Must belong to a comprehensive quote.

front.description: Photo of the front of the vehicle. JPG or PNG, up to 3 MB.

back.description: Photo of the rear of the vehicle. JPG or PNG, up to 3 MB.

right.description: Photo of the right-hand side of the vehicle. JPG or PNG, up to 3 MB.

left.description: Photo of the left-hand side of the vehicle. JPG or PNG, up to 3 MB.

chassis.description: Photo of the chassis (VIN) number. JPG or PNG, up to 3 MB.

attachments.description: The stored photo URLs, keyed by position.

409.description: The photos for this vehicle are already registered with the insurance provider

example.message: Attachments already exist for this vehicle.

422.description: A photo is missing, is not a JPG/PNG image, or is larger than 3 MB

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound for the policy date. For issued policies (`status=1`), this filters by `uploaded_at` (the provider policy issue timestamp) and falls back to `created_at` when `uploaded_at` is unavailable. For other statuses, this filters by `created_at`.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound for the policy date. For issued policies (`status=1`), this filters by `uploaded_at` (the provider policy issue timestamp) and falls back to `created_at` when `uploaded_at` is unavailable. For other statuses, this filters by `created_at`.

parameters.name: include_aggregates
parameters.description: When true, includes policy totals, total price, and monthly buckets for the filtered result set.

otp.description: The OTP received by the customer from the Issue OTP API

quote_request_id.description: ID of the car quote request

quote_reference_id.description: Unique identifier for the quote reference ID (coming from POST /quote-requests)

quote_price_id.description: Unique identifier for the quote price ID that exists inside a quote item (coming from POST /quote-requests)

items.description: UUID of a benefit (coming from POST /quote-request)

extra_fields.description: Optional free-form object with additional fields. Total JSON-encoded size must not exceed 255 characters.

422.description: Problem in the values that you submitted

example.message: The vin must be 17 characters. (and 3 more errors)

car_sequence_number: The car sequence number must be 9 digits.
new_owner_id: The new owner id must be 10 digits.
current_car_owner: The current owner id field cannot be empty.

post.description: Sends a quote verification OTP to the provided email and phone number. The OTP remains valid for 8 hours and can be reused for multiple quote requests during that period. Requesting a new quote OTP invalidates the previous one.

email.description: Email address of the car owner

phone.description: Phone number starting with 05 and containing 10 digits

owner_id.description: National ID or Iqama ID of the car owner (10 digits)

204.description: OTP sent successfully. The quote OTP is valid for 8 hours and can be reused during that period.

X-OTP-Expires-In.description: Number of seconds remaining until the quote OTP expires.

X-OTP-Expires-At.description: Exact quote OTP expiry time in ISO 8601 format.

message.example: Mobile is registered with different ID number

post.description: Sends a separate policy issuance OTP. This OTP is valid for 15 minutes and must be submitted to POST /policies before it expires. The 8-hour quote OTP validity does not apply to policy issuance.

email.description: Email address of the car owner

phone.description: Phone number starting with 05 and containing 10 digits

owner_id.description: National ID or Iqama ID of the car owner (10 digits)

quote_request_id.description: ID of the car quote request

quote_reference_id.description: Unique identifier for the quote reference ID (coming from POST /quote-requests)

quote_price_id.description: Unique identifier for the quote price ID that exists inside a quote item (coming from POST /quote-requests)

iban.description: The customer's Saudi IBAN (SA followed by 22 digits, no spaces). It is sent to the insurance provider with the payment OTP request and used to transfer claim settlements and refunds to the customer; the account is never charged.

204.description: OTP sent successfully. The policy issuance OTP is valid for 15 minutes.

car_sequence_number.description: The car sequence number from 9 digits

custom_number.description: Customs card number for an imported vehicle. Present when custom_number was used in the request.

maker_code.description: Vehicle maker code used to register a customs-card vehicle.

model_code.description: Vehicle model code used to register a customs-card vehicle.

body_type_code.description: Vehicle body-type code used to register a customs-card vehicle.

is_ownership_transfer.description: Whether it was a car transfer or not

car_estimated_cost.description: The estimated cost of the car

drivers.description: List of drivers associated with this quote request. Returned if drivers were provided in the request.

owner_id.description: Driver's national ID (starts with 1) or Iqama ID (starts with 2). Must be exactly 10 digits.

driving_percentage.description: Percentage of driving for this driver (25, 50, 75, or 100)

quotes.description: An array representing each insurance company quote. Each item has the company name, the prices, and the benefits.

company_name_ar.description: Arabic name of the insurance company. Use this field instead of `company_name` when rendering Arabic UIs.

type.description: Normalised insurance category used to group and filter quotes. Always one of `TPL`, `TPL +`, or `Comprehensive`.

insurance_type_display.description: The insurance type label exactly as the insurance provider intends it to be displayed. While `type` normalises all non-TPL / non-Comprehensive values into `TPL +`, this field preserves the original provider string (e.g. "TPL Plus", "Third Party Plus") and should be shown in the UI wherever the provider's own wording is preferred.

insurance_type_display_ar.description: Arabic translation of `insurance_type_display`. Use this field for Arabic UIs. Falls back to the English value for provider-specific types that do not have a translation.

company_logo_url.description: CDN URL for the insurance company's logo.

square_company_logo_url.description: CDN URL for the insurance company's square logo.

prices.description: An array representing each price. This will have the premium and the deductible

benefits.description: An array representing the different benefits offered by the company. Some of them are free and comes with the insurance, some are paid and optional

updated_at.description: In case of an update on this quote, this date will change

id.description: Yasmina ID for the quote. You can use it to delete items or showing it again to the customer

company_name_ar.description: Arabic name of the insurance company. Use this field instead of `company_name` when rendering Arabic UIs.

type.description: Normalised insurance category used to group and filter quotes. Always one of `TPL`, `TPL +`, or `Comprehensive`.

insurance_type_display.description: The insurance type label exactly as the insurance provider intends it to be displayed. While `type` normalises all non-TPL / non-Comprehensive values into `TPL +`, this field preserves the original provider string (e.g. "TPL Plus", "Third Party Plus") and should be shown in the UI wherever the provider's own wording is preferred.

insurance_type_display_ar.description: Arabic translation of `insurance_type_display`. Use this field for Arabic UIs. Falls back to the English value for provider-specific types that do not have a translation.

company_logo_url.description: CDN URL for the insurance company's logo.

square_company_logo_url.description: CDN URL for the insurance company's square logo.

name_ar.description: Arabic name of the benefit. Use this field instead of `name` when rendering Arabic UIs.

uploaded_at.description: Timestamp when the provider policy document was attached. For issued motor policies this is the closest available issue/purchase timestamp.

QuoteRequestAggregates.description: Returned only when include_aggregates is true.

by_month.description: Monthly quote request counts keyed by YYYY-MM.

PolicyAggregates.description: Returned only when include_aggregates is true.

by_month.description: Monthly policy counts and sales totals keyed by YYYY-MM. For issued policies (`status=1`), buckets use `uploaded_at` and fall back to `created_at`.
